summary: Tested the device registry feature (saved devices, rename, delete) end to end. Backend: 6 of 6 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_devices.py (3 runs in a row after adding retry logic to the test sim). Covered: GET /api/devices fields and backfill, socket device:register upsert, connections and last_seen, the online flag, PUT and DELETE admin-only (technician gets 403), 404 and 422, renaming a live device (queue:update shows the new name and the custom name survives a reconnect), and deleting an offline device (its sessions and logs are removed and it comes back as new). Deleting a live device keeps the session running with the original name. Frontend: devices-link works for admin and technician. /crm/aparelhos shows the list, count, search (name, platform and an empty state), LIGADO/DESLIGADO badges, renaming with Enter or the save button plus a toast, Escape to cancel, the delete dialog and confirm, and the renamed name in the Fila de Atendimento. The technician sees 0 rename and 0 delete buttons. One real bug found: a race in device_register leaves ghost 'waiting' sessions in the queue (it existed before this feature but shows up in the queue).

minor.issue: Race condition. When the device socket drops while device_register is still running its awaits, the disconnect handler runs first and does nothing because DEVICE_SIDS has no entry yet. Then device_register still inserts the session as 'waiting', writes DEVICE_SIDS[sid] for a dead sid, and sio.enter_room raises 'ValueError: sid is not connected to requested namespace' (traceback in backend.err.log). Result: ghost 'waiting' sessions that stay in the Fila until the backend restarts, a leaked DEVICE_SIDS entry (it can mark the device online=true for good), and connections is still incremented. Reproduced 2 times in 25 register attempts (about 8%) on the preview ingress. The UI queue showed duplicate entries (2x 'TEST Phone Final', 2x 'TEST UI Delete') plus stale ones.
Only removes sessions with status 'ended', so ghost waiting sessions from the race above survive the delete.
Every reconnect (including transport drops) adds a new session and increments connections, so the 'N ligações' counter is inflated by network blips.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape cancels editing but does not reset the local name state (only the X button does). Reopening rename shows the discarded text ('SHOULD NOT SAVE') instead of the current name. The name state is also only set once from d.display_name, so it goes stale after a rename by someone else or after a reload.

integration_issues.issue: Duplicate or ghost queue items caused by the backend device_register race (see backend minor issue).

issues: Plurals: shows '1 ligações' and '1 ligados agora'. Should be '1 ligação' and '1 ligado agora'.

action_items: device_register: after the awaits, check the sid is still connected (or wrap enter_room in try/except). If it is gone, mark the just-inserted session 'ended' and do not leave it in DEVICE_SIDS. Better: call enter_room and set DEVICE_SIDS before the DB writes, and have disconnect handle it.
DELETE /api/devices: also end or clean up non-live 'waiting/assigned' sessions whose session id is not in DEVICE_SIDS.
Devices.jsx: reset name to d.display_name when Escape is pressed or rename is opened (or sync it with useEffect on d.display_name).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py device_register: the order of DB insert, then DEVICE_SIDS write, then enter_room with no guard causes the ghost sessions and the registry leak.
list_devices runs sessions.distinct over all live session ids on every call and the page polls every 10s. Fine at the current scale.
A device_id containing '/' would break the PUT/DELETE path even with encodeURIComponent (FastAPI does not match %2F). Low risk.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6) of feature tests; 1 minor race bug found separately
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; minor Escape stale-input bug)

seed_data_creation: All TEST_dev_*, TEST_loop_* and TEST_ui_* devices were deleted via the API, and their 4 ghost waiting sessions were marked ended directly in the DB. Sims were stopped.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use test_devices.py for regression. Its Sim class retries registration because the preview ingress drops about 8% of fresh WebSocket connections right after connect. After the main agent fixes the race, run /tmp/reg_loop.py-style loops (25 connect and register cycles) and check that no non-ended sessions remain afterwards.
rca of the issue: Ghost queue sessions: the client connects, emits device:register, and the WS drops. The server disconnect() runs while device_register is awaiting find_one_and_update/insert_one, and DEVICE_SIDS has no sid yet, so nothing is ended. device_register then resumes, inserts the session (status waiting), sets DEVICE_SIDS[sid], and sio.enter_room raises ValueError, so broadcast_queue is skipped. The session stays 'waiting' until restart. Fix: guard with a connected check after the awaits, or try/except around enter_room that ends the session and pops DEVICE_SIDS.
